upstreamDependency.sdkState: not installed; the port speaks the pinned wire contract

medicalRecordSummary.rule: ending a conversation sends one extra non-stream turn on the same session with the case-record system prompt and parses the JSON answer; the draft is never final until a doctor confirms it
medicalRecordSummary.offline: the deterministic on-device summary states that a doctor must assess the patient; it never invents a diagnosis
medicalRecordSummary.attachments: attachment names and kinds are named in the turn text; binaries stay on the device because the pinned agents API exposes no binary-upload operation

requiredInputs.accessToken: IAM/appbase session token through the shared session port; never a VITE_* variable

modeSelection.rule: hosted only when agentsApiBaseUrl is non-empty and an access token is present; never a silent offline fallback
modeSelection.observable: every port reports its own mode and each client renders it on the me tab

acceptance.criterion: A hosted conversation completes a session create plus a turn and returns assistant_output text.
An emergency red flag still yields TriageLevel.emergency and is never softened.
The me tab shows the active mode and never claims hosted when the offline adapter answers.
A real hosted conversation transcript against a deployed sdkwork-agents service.
acceptance.blockedUntil: An agents deployment plus an IAM access token in a target deployment profile.

blockedUntil: A deployed agents service and an IAM credential; every other acceptance criterion is verified against the pinned contract and a conformance server.
